title: Payroll Report
description: Cost of labor: earnings mix, overtime, differentials, wage parity and taxes.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Payroll. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Cost of labor: earnings mix, overtime, differentials, wage parity and taxes.

Regular pay should dominate; growing OT, retro or bonus slices need a reason.

Blended-rate OT is the FLSA true-up for employees with differentials.

**Ask:** what drives the change versus last period?
Where gross pay goes and which roles earn overtime.

On-Demand Pay repayments come out of net pay - watch for heavy users.

**Ask:** is overtime concentrated in a few roles?
How people are paid and the cost of labor per location.

Pay cards help unbanked staff; paper checks cost the most to run.

**Ask:** which location has the highest employer cost per employee?
